personal_details.body_type: Petite Rectangle — balanced shoulders, waist, hips, short stature

overall_style: Soft-Strong Feminine. Structured silhouettes, clean lines, elegant and modest. Feminine but not girly. Quiet luxury energy. Prefers pointed toes, slim shoes, structured bags.
presentation_goals: Intentional, comfortable, emotionally aligned — not trendy or loud
proportion_rules: Pointed toe shoes elongate legs — always preferred
Avoid round toes — make legs look shorter
Avoid masculine loafers — not aligned with aesthetic
lifestyle_needs: Walks long distances daily (LRT to office) — comfort is non-negotiable
Needs outfits that transition between office, casual, and social
